critical_code_review_comments: L1L2ReportPage.js table caps render at 1000 rows and prepends all L1 rows before L2 rows in l1_l2_report_service.build_l1_l2_report (items = l1_rows + l2_rows). With 5539 L1 rows, the initial 'All Levels' table view shows ZERO L2 badges until the user filters to Level 2 or searches - a Level-2 sample row is invisible in the first 1000 by default. Consider interleaving by root_product_id (or default-sorting by root+level) so L2 rows are discoverable without filtering. Not a defect since the truncation notice + level filter clearly expose the full set.

l1_l2_report_service.build_l1_l2_report calls bom_collection.find twice back-to-back (root_docs then l1_docs). Fine at 3684+~9k docs but could use bulk_prefetch's own return value if it were adjusted to return docs, saving one Mongo round trip. Purely nit.

context_for_next_testing_agent: L1/L2 report cache lives in Mongo collection l1_l2_report_cache._id='latest' and is served instantly by GET /api/admin/l1-l2-report. Generation is a background job: POST /api/admin/l1-l2-report/generate returns {job_id}, poll GET /api/admin/l1-l2-report/generate/{job_id} (status: running|done|failed). Live sweep takes ~65s. To hit the endpoints from Playwright, seed a super_admin auth_user + auth_sessions doc and set the vms_session cookie. Deep-backfill loop is @app.on_event('startup') in server.py with 180s initial delay and 24h period; look for 'Deep UUID backfill background run complete' in backend logs to confirm.
